newsitem.title: USA: Southwestern Energy unit files for rate hike.
newsitem.headline: Southwestern Energy unit files for rate hike.

text.p: Southwestern Energy Co.'s Associated Natural Gas Co unit said it filed an application with the Missouri Public Service Commission to implement a $3.8 million -- or 10.23 percent -- total annual rate increase in three of its Missouri operating districts.
The increase is subject to review and approval by the MPSC, the company said, and will likely not become effective until late 1997, if approved.
The unit, a division of Southwestern's Arkansas Western Gas Co, serves about 47,000 Missouri customers.
The unit's last rate increase became effcetive in November, 1990.
